name: Subtitle Sync
overview: Align external SRT subtitles with the first audio track.
description: Align external SRT subtitles to a video’s first audio track and save synced copies. Includes a live dashboard and bundled ffsubsync for Linux x86-64 and ARM64.

versions.changelog: Browse every library in the dashboard. Each movie and episode shows Jellyfin artwork and how many external SRT tracks have a synced copy.
Adds the admin dashboard, track-level progress, incremental batch sync and bundled ffsubsync for Linux x86-64 and ARM64.
Initial release with audio-based timing correction for external SRT subtitles.
